description: Defines data structures, constants, and classes related to disk cache block file format, including index headers, cache entries, and ranking nodes, for managing on-disk cache storage in Chromium.

classes.name: IndexHeader
classes.description: Header structure for the master index file, containing metadata about cache entries, versioning, and cache state.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: Represents the entire index file structure, including header and hash table.

classes.name: EntryStore
classes.description: Main structure for a cache entry, including key, hash, data pointers, and metadata.

classes.name: RankingsNode
classes.description: Stores ranking and LRU information for cache entries.
